pluginText.pf.safety: {"stops the booking":[{"words":"A gas smell, hissing, or a carbon monoxide alarm","says":"Leave the house now. Then call 911 and the gas company.","booking":"No booking. A new request must say the gas company cleared the house."},{"words":"Someone hurt, sparks, or water on wiring or a panel","says":"Get away from the water and call 911.","booking":"No booking until it's safe; the customer can come back."}],"safety steps, then the booking goes on, marked urgent":[{"words":"Water spraying, flooding, or water near outlets","says":"Shut the main water valve. Stay away from outlets and anything plugged in."},{"words":"Sewage coming up into the home","says":"Keep people and pets away, and don't run any water or drains."},{"words":"No heat from a gas water heater, with no smell","says":"Don't relight it if you smell gas. If there's no smell, the plumber checks it."}],"at the counter":"A gas part, gas valve or gas appliance control isn't worked on at the counter. The customer is offered a home visit by a plumber with the gas-line skill.","general screen":"Always on: danger to life, fire, gas, or a medical emergency gets 'call 911' first."}
pluginText.pf.first_steps: {"before the main visit":[{"step":"An estimate visit (free), or photos first","for":"Water heater replacement and other big jobs","timing":"Before the quote; the owner picks which"},{"step":"A permit","for":"Water heater replacement, gas line work, and jobs the local rules name","timing":"Pulled by the business before the work, where the local rules require one (a to-do for the owner)"},{"step":"A utility locate (call 811) before any digging","for":"Yard lines and sewer lines","timing":"Done by the business, with the lead time the locate service sets"},{"step":"A lead-safe work notice","for":"Work that opens painted walls in an older home","timing":"Signed on the secure page before the visit, where the rules require it"},{"step":"The owner's OK","for":"Gas line work, and same-day jobs","timing":"Before the booking is confirmed"},{"step":"A part check (the old part brought in)","for":"A special-order part at the counter","timing":"At least 2 days before; stays good 3 months"}],"prep for the reminder":["Clear the area under the sink, or around the water heater","Know where the main water valve is","Put pets in another room","At the counter: bring the faucet or part with all its pieces; drain a pump before a drop-off"]}
pluginText.pf.visit: {"check-in at the customer's place":"The check-in code at the door. The work starts at once only if the customer asks for that in writing, where the rules allow it.","before work":"Photos of the area before work; the year the home was built before opening a wall.","proof it's done":"The plumber texts DONE with the bill's lines, and photos after. pluginText.pf.rules: {"written estimate":"A written estimate before work above an amount: from the state form.","right to cancel":"A written right to cancel for work sold at the home: where the rules require it.","permits":"Pulled by the business where the local rules require one; the inspection follows.","lead-safe work":"Lead-safe work rules for older homes: where the rules require it.","license on papers":"The license number on quotes and bills: from the state form.","digging":"A utility locate before any digging: always.","declared emergency":"Price limits in a declared emergency: where the state's rules require it.","warranty":"The owner's own (the example: 1 year on labor), shown on the receipt.","state notices":"A state's own notices for home repairs, like a right-to-repair notice: from the state form, sent before the work or with the quote.","records":"7 years, as for every kind of work."}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"all":"Every edge case is handled the general way. These matter most for plumbing:","plumbing":["The leak gets worse before the visit: the safety steps again, then urgent","A gas smell at any point: stop, get out, call 911 and the gas company","After hours: sent now to the plumber on call, then the backup; nobody takes it means no visit tonight and nothing charged","Nobody home at the door: the no-show steps, with the owner's OK before any fee","A renter whose landlord pays: the landlord's OK first, or the renter pays instead; work over the landlord's top amount goes to the landlord first","A bigger job found (a cracked drain in the wall): its own quote, OK'd by the owner over the limit","Mold, lead paint or a hazard behind a wall: stop, and a written note","A storm brings many calls: PAUSE, and a declared emergency's price limits","At the counter: a part that can't be rebuilt, a gas part, or a drop-off nobody picks up"]}
